operator_assessment.operator_summary: Deterministic hard verification passes (0 violations) and the fresh export correctly reflects today's canonical change (Skien U11 rvv-0013 reverted to 2026-10-10 10:00; Skien JU10 rvv-0007 unchanged at 2026-11-21 17:00). However the season-wide publication readiness gate reports REVIEW_REQUIRED: this is a large, still-developing 180-tournament season with substantial pre-existing manual work outstanding, unrelated to today's edit. It is not ready for public publication yet.

key_tradeoffs.title: Skien U11 reverted into its original holiday-week date
key_tradeoffs.summary: No legal alternative existed to relieve the late 2026-10-17 17:30 evening slot (Skien ice is congested on essentially every other Saturday checked); operator explicitly accepted reverting to 2026-10-10 10:00, which is the date the club originally flagged as a holiday-week conflict.

remaining_actions.title: 111 participation-target deviations and 24 target-deviation findings across the season
remaining_actions.summary: Large number of teams below/above configured participation targets; needs review before publication.

remaining_actions.title: 12 tournament placement shortfalls (unplaced obligations)
remaining_actions.summary: Genuine unplaced tournament obligations remain across several age groups/dates; still need manual placement.

remaining_actions.title: 14 hosting-balance imbalances
remaining_actions.summary: Several clubs have hosting counts off target; needs review.

remaining_actions.title: 2 external calendar conflicts, 1 pending host-confirmation dependency
remaining_actions.summary: Existing manual/host-confirmation work (unrelated to today's Skien U11/JU10 investigation) still open.

limitations: Did not independently re-verify every one of the 111 participation deviations or 12 unplaced obligations individually; relying on the deterministic evidence summary.
Only Skien's calendar evidence was independently cross-checked in this session.

checklist_findings.question: Antall cuper pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 142 lag; 111 deltakelses-avvik og 24 måltallsavvik registrert på tvers av sesongen (ikke forårsaket av dagens endring). Krever gjennomgang.

checklist_findings.question: Antall hjemmeturneringer pr lag?
checklist_findings.finding: 14 hosting-balance imbalances registrert; ikke forårsaket av dagens endring, men fortsatt åpne.

checklist_findings.question: Lengde på turneringer?
checklist_findings.finding: Ingen avvik funnet i eksport-konsistens eller deterministisk verifikasjon knyttet til turneringslengde.

checklist_findings.question: Er det faktisk ledig tid på is?
checklist_findings.finding: Uavhengig kontrollert i denne sesjonen: alle 8 Skien-vertede turneringer (inkl. dagens flyttede rvv-0013 til 2026-10-10 10:00) faller innenfor faktisk ledig is basert på Skien sin egen kalenderkilde. Ingen kollisjon funnet.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar vertsklubben i samme turnering?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministisk verifikasjon rapporterer ok=true, ingen brudd.

checklist_findings.question: Deltar hvert lag maksimalt én gang per dag?
checklist_findings.finding: Deterministisk verifikasjon rapporterer ok=true, ingen brudd på dette punktet.

checklist_findings.question: Er det normalt maks 2 lag fra samme klubb, med 3 kun som synlig unntak?
checklist_findings.finding: Ingen brudd rapportert av deterministisk verifikasjon (hard_max_club_teams_per_tournament=3 respektert).

checklist_findings.question: Er eksportformatene konsistente?
checklist_findings.finding: export_consistency_summary viser matches_plan=true for csv_games, csv_overview, csv_team_counts, ical og excel; ingen mismatches.

checklist_findings.question: Ser harnesset andre materielle problemer eller manglende regler vi ikke allerede har tenkt på?
checklist_findings.finding: Sesongen har fortsatt betydelig gjenstående manuelt arbeid uavhengig av dagens endring: 12 uplasserte turneringsforpliktelser, 2 eksterne kalenderkonflikter, 1 ventende vertsbekreftelse (movable_busy). Dette er kjente, ikke-blokkerende funn men gjør sesongen ikke klar for offentlig publisering ennå.
